difficulty_reason: The new core is the state-dependent anti/synchronous coupling rule: reverse the right-deck coin exactly at crossed card matches, otherwise synchronize the coin. This preserves already synchronized cards, gives an exact inward probability for each unsynchronized card, and bounds its outward probability despite dependence on the entire two-deck state. The proof then couples this non-Markov distance to an absorbing reflecting path walk, uses a uniform remaining absorption-time bound for repeated time blocks, and combines all cards. The coupling design and conditional domination are counted inside this unit, not imported as free prerequisites.
